scope: Integrated local pipeline with real SQLite persistence and synthetic provisioner, quality evaluator, access and mail adapters. No deployed bridge, real agent creation, OAuth consent, email delivery, sale, charge or production change.
checks: Signed order received with the same management number
Retry persists one order; changed content rejected
Invalid signatures, expired envelopes and secrets in payload rejected
Customer cannot retrieve another customer or merchant order
Configuration and quality checks persist before uncertain delivery
Restart and retry recover one agent and one synthetic email
Customer recovers status by original management number without factory internals
A failed quality check blocks delivery
No delivery when provisioner expands permissions
